# Thrill Edge Technologies

> Thrill Edge Technologies is a custom software development company delivering AI, web, mobile, and SaaS products. We ship production-ready software for startups and enterprises across the United States, UK, Canada, and Australia.

## Services

- [AI & ML Solutions](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/ai-ml-solutions): custom AI models, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, and generative AI integrations.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/ai-workflow-automation): automated business processes and AI-powered workflow systems.
- [Custom Web Development](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/custom-web-development): scalable web platforms, portals, and enterprise applications.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/ui-ux-design): product design, research, and interface design for web and mobile.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/mobile-app-development): native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps.
- [MVP & Product Strategy](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/mvp-product-strategy): validation, scoping, and rapid MVP delivery for founders.
- [SaaS Solutions](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/saas-solutions): multi-tenant SaaS platforms, subscriptions, and billing.
- [Shopify Plus Agency](https://www.thrilledge.com/services/shopify-plus-agency): high-growth eCommerce builds on Shopify Plus.

## Industries

- Healthcare, Fintech, eCommerce, Real Estate, Education, Logistics, and Blockchain.
